Brand story

From Lebanon.
To the world.

Lebanese people have always been known for their distinctive sense of style. Essaint was created during the war from a belief in our country, its people and its potential.

We believe every Lebanese person deserves refined, well-made clothing at an accessible price. Proudly crafted in Lebanon, Essaint represents resilience, ambition and hope for what comes next.
